statement.en: This level is set at Peggy's Cove, in Nova Scotia. Discover Canada says the Bay of Fundy has the world's highest tides. It says the province's identity is tied to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Peggy's Cove, en Nouvelle-Écosse. Découvrir le Canada dit que la baie de Fundy a les plus hautes marées du monde. Le guide dit aussi que l'identité de la province tient à la construction navale, à la pêche et au transport maritime.

source.quote: Known for the world’s highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping.

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. Known for the world’s highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping. … Picture: (Right) Peggy’s Cove harbour, Nova Scotia

blurb.en: The first French settlers reached these Maritime shores in 1604. The people descended from them are the Acadians.
blurb.fr: Les premiers colons français sont arrivés sur les côtes des Maritimes en 1604. Leurs descendants sont les Acadiens.

source.quote: The Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604.

verification.evidence: The Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604.

blurb.en: This is Peggy's Point Lighthouse. Nova Scotia's identity is linked to building ships, to fishing and to shipping.
blurb.fr: Voici le phare de Peggy's Point. L'identité de la Nouvelle-Écosse est liée à la construction navale, à la pêche et au transport maritime.

source.quote: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. Known for the world’s highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping.

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. Known for the world’s highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping.

blurb.en: Sheds like this one hold the gear a working harbour needs, and someone's hands built every one of them. In the last two hundred years, millions of newcomers have helped to build this country and to defend the way of life here. People who came from somewhere else are part of what made Canada.
blurb.fr: Des hangars comme celui-ci abritent le matériel dont un port en activité a besoin, et chacun a été bâti par des mains humaines. Depuis deux cents ans, des millions de nouveaux arrivants ont aidé à bâtir ce pays et à défendre le mode de vie qu'on y trouve. Les personnes venues d'ailleurs font partie de ce qui a fait le Canada.

source.quote: over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

verification.evidence: over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

blurb.en: Behind a door like this one, you might hear many different languages. Languages other than English and French are widely spoken in Canadian homes.
blurb.fr: Derrière une porte comme celle-ci, on peut entendre bien des langues. Les langues autres que l'anglais et le français se parlent couramment dans les foyers canadiens.

source.quote: Non-official languages are widely spoken in Canadian homes.

verification.evidence: Non-official languages are widely spoken in Canadian homes.
